question: Which named form is identified as the terrifying skull-bearer also called the eighth destroyer?
premises: Kapālī is named as terrifying and also.
That same figure is called the eighth, remembered as destroyer.
The verse links these epithets to one form.
inference: Kapālī, also terrifying, is remembered as the eighth destroyer (Saṃhāra).
uncertainties: Whether all three tokens refer to a single deity or a list is read from context.
plain_english: Kapālī, also terrifying, and the destroyer is remembered as the eighth.
